extDescription.message: Send downloads and links to CYRON Manager without leaving the browser.

commandSend.message: Send the current page to CYRON

captureHint.message: New downloads can be sent to CYRON automatically.

excludeHint.message: Manual sends still work on this site.

feedbackDuplicate.message: This download is already in CYRON.

feedbackInvalid.message: Enter a valid http or https link.

errorOffline.message: CYRON is not running or the browser bridge is off.

errorRejected.message: CYRON did not accept this link.

errorPermissions.message: Permission is required to read cookies for this site.

askMessage.message: The download is paused in the browser.

notifyAddedBody.message: The download is now in the CYRON queue.

notifyKeptBody.message: The download continues in the browser.

notifyErrorTitle.message: CYRON could not take the download

optionsIntro.message: Connect Chrome or Edge to CYRON Manager. Links and downloads stay on this computer.

serverHint.message: Keep the port equal to the Browser Integration port in CYRON.

cookieHint.message: Only used when CYRON asks for cookies for a browser download. CYRON encrypts them on disk and clears them when the download completes.

cookieNotNeeded.message: Cookie forwarding is off in CYRON.

cookiePermissionNeeded.message: CYRON asks for cookies, but this extension does not have permission.

reloadHint.message: After updating CYRON, open chrome://extensions and reload this extension.

errorServer.message: The CYRON address is not valid.

errorForbidden.message: CYRON rejected this extension. Reload the extension and check the address.

errorBusy.message: CYRON is receiving too many requests. Try again in a moment.

recentError.message: Could not read the download list.

connectionOffline.message: Open CYRON and keep browser integration on.

siteUnavailable.message: This page has no web address.

feedbackExcluded.message: Capture is off for this site.

feedbackIncluded.message: Capture is on for this site.

captureModeHelp.message: This value comes from CYRON settings.

cookieHintOptions.message: Cookies are read only when CYRON asks for them while adding a browser download.

excludedHint.message: Add or remove sites from the extension popup.

testUnsaved.message: Connected. Save this address to keep using it.
